name: google-search-console
description: Google Search Console MCP server and CLI for Claude Code, Codex and AI agents. 19 tools for search analytics, URL inspection, sitemaps and property verification.
long_description:
Connects Claude to Google Search Console: the queries, pages, impressions, rankings, indexing and sitemaps Google recorded for your sites.

Sign in once from a terminal with `npx -y @thenavidm/google-search-console-mcp-cli login`, and the extension uses that account from then on. Or point it at a Google service account key file that has been added to your properties.

Deleting a property or a sitemap refuses to run without an explicit confirmation. Turn Read only on to remove every write from the tool list.

service_account_key.title: Service account key (optional)
service_account_key.description: A Google service account JSON key that has been added to your Search Console properties. Leave empty if you signed in with the login command.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that can add, verify or delete a property or a sitemap.
